proposal.thesis: Costco is the pre-committed diversifier for a book that is ~89% cash and one software_platforms seat (NOW). Fiscal Q4 2026 (reported 2026-09-24) cleared the bar: net sales $93.87B (+11.2% y/y), comps +9.4% (+6.7% ex gas/FX), digitally enabled comps +19.5%, membership fee income +7.3% with U.S./Canada renewal 92.3% (+10bp q/q), and EPS $6.75 (ex the $0.15 tariff-refund benefit still ~+12% y/y). Live mark ~$914 sits on our stated $915 would_buy with starter_zone true on a fresh Alpaca IEX overlay — the exact 10:30 full-slot condition the 8:45 run deferred to. Structure remains below the 50/200-DMA with a soft weekly trend, so this is an honest half-risk starter, not a full-size chase; the edge is post-print membership/comp durability into the 2026-10-07 September sales print while the rest of the book stays AI/software-skewed.
catalysts: September sales results after the close 2026-10-07
Continued executive-membership penetration and renewal-rate stability into Q1 FY27
proposal.macro_context: Regime is supportive for adding long swing risk (SPY above the 200-DMA, VIX mid-teens, no active stress flags). Elevated 10y yields argue for quality compounders with membership-fee visibility over pure duration-sensitive software adds; COST's broad_market driver diversifies the existing NOW seat.
proposal.risk_map: Kill if September/October sales comps decelerate sharply ex-gas/FX, renewal rates roll over, or price closes below $888 on rising volume (structure failure under the starter stop). Early warn: traffic/ticket weakness in the 10/07 sales release or a decisive break and close back under ~$900 while SPY holds up.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: street still frames COST as a rich defensive compounder after a clean Q4 beat, with the stock digesting below its moving averages and soft 1m relative strength (−3.2% vs SPY). MY VIEW: the post-print membership and comp tape is stronger than the chart look, and at our pre-committed $915 level the mispricing is patience premium, not broken fundamentals. MECHANISM: the market is anchoring on weekly downtrend/below-200DMA optics and the one-time $0.15 tariff-refund EPS line, while underweighting that ex-refund EPS still grew ~12% with digital comps +19.5% and renewals rising — i.e. treating a digestion phase as thesis damage. RESOLUTION: the 2026-10-07 September sales release (and October sales thereafter) either re-accelerates traffic/ticket or confirms a softer run-rate; that print is where the digestion narrative gets marked to reality.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: September or October 2026 sales release showing a sharp comps deceleration ex-gas and FX, or a renewal-rate drop that implies membership flywheel damage versus the Q4 92.3% U.S./Canada rate.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: Daily close below $888 on rising volume, or a decisive break and hold under $900 while SPY remains above its 200-DMA (stock-specific failure, not a market washout).
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If COST has not reclaimed and held above $960 within 25 calendar days of entry, cut or exit — the post-print digestion thesis will have failed to resolve.

proposal.thesis: Celestica is an AI-server/systems OEM with a surviving pocket_pivot after digesting a deep drawdown from the 52-week high, while hyperscaler networking and custom-compute demand remains the binding bottleneck narrative. Latest reported quarter showed revenue +77% YoY with net debt modest versus TTM EBITDA, FCF positive, and SBC under 1% of sales — an EMS profile that can monetize Google/OpenAI-linked data-center programs without software-multiple fragility. Bernstein’s fresh Outperform/$520 framing and a Strong Buy Street cluster with mean target near $474 underwrite a measured move into the mid-$400s if the 1.6T switch and TPU-adjacent ramps hold. We size this as a half-risk calibration probe because gross margin is thin and the October 26 print sits inside the swing window.
catalysts: 2026-10-26 earnings/guide on FY26 $20.5B revenue path and 1.6T networking ramp
Hyperscaler capex updates confirming AI server/networking attach through Q4 2026
proposal.macro_context: Regime hint is supportive with momentum factor healthy and VIX mid-teens; rising nominal yields are a headwind for long-duration growth but CLS is an AI-supplier hardware cash-flow story, not a rate-proxy multiple. Soft oil and Friday’s weaker jobs print are secondary to data-center capex for this seat.
proposal.risk_map: Early tells: daily close back under $350 on rising volume, a guide cut versus the $20.5B FY26 revenue marker, or hyperscaler capex freeze headlines that hit peer OEMs (SMCI/DELL/HPE) together while SPY is flat. Thin ~12% gross margin means any mix shift shows up fast in operating leverage.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: Street clusters Strong Buy with mean target near $474 and Bernstein at $520, treating CLS as a prime networking-bottleneck winner on Google/OpenAI data-center spend after a sharp rally that also drew a Zacks cut to Hold. MY VIEW: the pocket_pivot after a −21% drawdown from the 52-week high is a better entry geometry than chasing HPE’s +8% post-Investor-Day bounce above our own $63 level, and the OEM cash-conversion profile is cleaner than SMCI’s negative FCF. MECHANISM: consensus still underweights how much AI cluster buildouts are gated by switch/optics/systems integration capacity rather than GPU scarcity alone — CLS monetizes that bottleneck with low SBC and modest net debt, so incremental revenue drops through without SaaS-like dilution. RESOLUTION: the 2026-10-26 print and any FY26/1.6T commentary will show whether revenue is tracking the $20.5B marker and whether margins stabilize; failure to hold the mid-$350s into that window kills the probe.

thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: October 26 2026 earnings or guide that cuts FY26 revenue below the ~$20.5B marker, or shows a sharp gross-margin break that implies AI-program pricing or utilization damage.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: Daily close below $350 on rising volume, or a decisive break and hold under the recent pocket-pivot low while SPY remains above its 200-DMA (stock-specific failure).
thesis_invalidators.time_box: If CLS has not reclaimed and held above $420 within 20 calendar days of entry — and before the October 26 print if still open — cut or exit; the post-digestion continuation thesis will have failed to resolve.
